fields.statement: An in-process rhiza daemon line (rhiza daemon --once) runs ctx.Adopt and ctx.Reap with the test binary's pid: adoptList lists every child of that process, other scripts' exec children too, and reapList Wait4s them, so a parallel script's exec fails with 'waitid: no child processes' (seen twice in TestScripts/^[a-d]: daemon-continue-slot:31, daemon-resume-landed-plan:37). Three a-d scripts already run the daemon loop in-process (daemon-event-hook, daemon-load-settings, daemon-notify-disk-low; workflow-plan-autonomy in s-w too). Should run() leave Adopt and Reap nil for an in-process call (a change to run()/ctx.go), or should those scripts go back on processScripts with exec rhiza? This retry kept the 18 other daemon scripts on the list for this reason instead of converting them.
